amount().notice: Underlying units minted and wrapped per claim.

waitOf(address).notice: Seconds until `account` may claim again (0 = now).

userdoc.notice: Test stakes in one call: mints the public underlying of Zama's confidential USDC         (USDCMock, publicly mintable on Sepolia) and wraps it straight to the player, who         receives an encrypted cUSDCMock balance. Anyone may claim for anyone (the browser's         session key tops the player up without a wallet pop-up), once per cooldown per account.
